mintAuthority.summary: savUSD is an immutable, deposit-only receipt over avUSD on Avalanche. Its local share minting is bounded by deposited avUSD, its base-asset mint authority is inherited from the separately reviewed avUSD profile, and its active peripheral burn/mint controllers are covered by the reviewed bridge-route inventory.

controls.label: savUSD savings vault (StakedAvUSDV2, non-upgradeable)
controls.evidence: At Avalanche block 87752599: owner() = 0xd4d23209aae8630bf386b7393763a5b7865e57cb; hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, owner) = true; proxiableUUID() reverts; EIP-1967 proxy admin and impl slots = zero (not an upgradeable proxy). StakedAvUSDV2 ABI (Routescan verified): deposit-only minting, no privileged mint(). Ethereum deployment 0xb8d89678... confirms same EOA owner. Deployer eth_getCode = 0x (EOA). No upgrade surface exists on the wrapper.

controls.label: Inherited avUSD issuer mint authority
controls.capDescription: Underlying avUSD minting requires supported collateral, route and signature validation, and the AvantMintingV2 per-block cap; savUSD inherits that base-asset issuance path.
controls.evidence: The separately reviewed avUSD parent establishes one active immutable AvantMintingV2 gateway at Avalanche block 90283689. savUSD asset() resolves to avUSD, so its base-asset mint authority is inherited from that verified gateway.

review.evidence: At Avalanche block 87752599, the canonical StakedAvUSDV2 contract returned avUSD as its asset, exposed deposit-only share issuance with no privileged mint function, and had zero EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots. The current avUSD parent review independently resolves the sole active AvantMintingV2 gateway through Avalanche block 90283689. The 2026-07-20 bridge-route review separately enumerates every tracked peripheral savUSD deployment and its Chainlink CCIP burn/mint pool, so those routes are not an unresolved local wrapper authority.
review.reviewer: P2 mint-free cohort; OpenAI Codex V9 curation
